question: What claim about transmission must hold for the teaching concerning the earth-moving good-eaters to be told by an earth-mover to the beloved?
premises: A teaching concerning the earth-moving good-eaters is in question.
The teller is an earth-mover, addressed to the beloved.
inference: An earth-mover has told the teaching concerning the earth-moving good-eaters to the beloved.
uncertainties: The content of that teaching is not given in this verse.
plain_english: The teaching of the earth-moving good-eaters has been told by an earth-mover, O beloved.
